ecoTips.tip: Rinse plastic food containers before tossing them into recycling bins to prevent batch contamination.
Separate dry and wet waste at source. This boosts municipal composting efficiency by up to 70%.
Never dispose of rechargeable or lithium-ion batteries in household trash—they are severe fire hazards.
Flatten all cardboard boxes before placing them in collection bins to maximize transport capacity.
Keep a small countertop caddy for fruit peels and coffee grounds to make home composting effortless.
Clean glass bottles can be recycled endlessly without loss of purity or quality.
